title: Pasture Weave Commons
rules: Every farmer has a selectable native action row. Transferable tools specialize herding, shearing, building and water work.
Livestock walk real corridors toward grass. Opening or neglecting a gate can expose a neighbor's recovering pasture to grazing.
Resting plots regrow faster; hay plots convert one grass to fodder instead of two. Animals still graze any accessible plot.
Shearing needs a rack, a woolly animal and another farmer choosing Hold within one tile of that animal.
Shared infected equipment can transmit disease and prevent quarantine cure. Clean it with carried water.
Quarantine pens have four actual places. Admitted animals stay confined until their timer expires and a farmer releases them.
Store fodder for drought, tend orchards, water troughs, build weather shelters or rescue hungry animals with a partner.
All dynamics are native source state. No generated scene, fixed script, human play or learning outcome has been executed.
